title: Linear Attention in Vision Transformers: Breaking the O(N²) Barrier
description: How to replace O(N²) softmax attention with O(N) linear attention using the kernel trick. Full math, L2ViT alternating design, Local Concentration Module, and Flash Attention — with PyTorch implementations.
venue: Based on L2ViT (Zheng et al., 2025) arXiv:2501.16182
